- **Short-term investments (December 31, 2011):** $199 million

  - Source: [HIG fiscal 2011 annual report (10-K)](documents/report.md)

## Calculation
To determine the percentage of the total collateral pledged that was associated with short-term investments in 2011:

\[
\text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Short-term investments}}{\text{Total collateral pledged}} \right) \times 100

\[
\text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{199}{1,285} \right) \times 100 \approx 15.49
cent
\]
